'''Fiddler 10''', also known as a '''Boiler Droid''', was a type of hovering [[Droid/Legends|droid]] owned and operated by [[Tig Fromm]] and the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]]. They worked inside [[Tig Fromm's base]] as a maintenance crew. While infiltrating the base, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] tried to pretend he was the maintenance crew but was caught when the actual droids showed up.<ref name="WW">{{DroidsCite|The White Witch}}</ref> The droids were also present in the Fromm Gang prison.<ref name="Escape">[[Star Wars: Droids (video game)|''Star Wars: Droids'' video game]]</ref>
